option_relations.rationale: Developmental delay is a symptom/finding, not a specific diagnosis in the context of the provided leaves.

RASA1-related disorders (Capillary Malformation-Arteriovenous Malformation Syndrome) is a specific genetic disorder involving vascular malformations, but it is not equivalent to Sturge-Weber syndrome, nor is it a direct supertype or subtype in the provided leaves.
Vascular malformation of the nose is a specific finding/manifestation, not a comprehensive diagnosis, and is not equivalent to Sturge-Weber syndrome.
Concurrent Microcephaly-capillary malformation syndrome (MIC-CAP) and Mowat-Wilson syndrome (MWS) are distinct genetic syndromes and are not equivalent to Sturge-Weber syndrome.
